title: Issue Channels and Value Limits — Gift Cards & Store Credit
content:
Every Gift Cards & Store Credit instrument type is issued through one channel only, and every instrument is issued for a value no lower than its type's minimum issue value and holds a balance no higher than its type's maximum balance. Computed issue values are rounded half up to the cent for all six types.

## Schedule of channels and value limits

| Instrument type | The only issue channel | Promotional value | Minimum issue value (USD) | Maximum balance (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Marlowe Rewards Note | Loyalty conversion | Yes | 20.00 | 1000.00 |
| Bonus Gift Card | Gift-card promotion | Yes | 20.00 | 100.00 |
| Goodwill Credit | Service recovery | Yes | 5.00 | 250.00 |
| Return Store Credit | Return refund | No | 0.01 (any positive amount) | 5000.00 |
| Marlowe & Finch Gift Card | Purchase | No | 10.00 | 500.00 |
| Marlowe & Finch e-Gift Card | Purchase | No | 10.00 | 500.00 |

| Instrument type | Rounding of computed issue values | Purchase price refundable if the card is returned |
|---|---|---|
| Every type listed above | Half up to the cent | No |

## Terms used in the schedule

- **Promotional value** marks value that was given free rather than paid for. Promotional value takes the instrument outside gift-card law protections. The three promotional types are the Marlowe Rewards Note, the Bonus Gift Card and Goodwill Credit; Return Store Credit and both purchased gift cards carry paid-for value.
- **Purchase price refundable** answers whether a purchased gift card can be returned for a refund of its price. For every Gift Cards & Store Credit type the answer is no.

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical figures)

- A Return Store Credit can be issued for as little as one cent; a Goodwill Credit is never issued for less than 5.00 and a purchased gift card never for less than 10.00.
- A hypothetical computed issue value of 12.345 is issued as 12.35; one of 12.344 is issued as 12.34.
- A Marlowe & Finch e-Gift Card never holds more than 500.00, and a Bonus Gift Card never more than 100.00.
